sql: select e.key, i.kind, i.severity, i.detected_at, i.resolved_at, left(i.description,160) as description from experiment_integrity_events i join experiments e on e.id=i.experiment_id where i.detected_at >= '2026-10-16 14:00' or (e.key in ('mmsell-win-set','mmsell-price-ceiling-cell-size') and i.resolved_at is null) order by i.id desc limit 15
